searchText: Ok let me know if you think there could be an issue in Besu. I had a quick look and i did not find anything wrong. <@!574864862338088960> (chainspec file - we use the Parity/OE format) <@!574864862338088960> Would be nice to see the naming of `gas limit` changed to `gas target` in the tooling to encourage propagation of that name going forward. I think continuing to call that field in the block `gas limit` is going to lead to confusion long term. that makes sense > <@!574864862338088960> <@!489256758989029405> thanks <@!552133098075193354> The link to `Mainnet readiness checklist review` link doesn't work for anyone who doesn't have edit access to that page. The link in the agenda. https://github.com/ethereum/pm/blob/master/Fee%20Market%20Meetings/mainnet-readiness.md <@!332923501079953409> FWIW I agree with you that supporting "signed transactions from 3 years ago forever" is going to eventually end poorly, but it isn't a hill I have wanted to die on yet. 😕 My hunch is that may be something we decide to drop as part of the Eth1 -> Eth2 migration too
